name: Villambistia (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided blue over white, the blue charged with two yellow scallop shells.
history: The neighbourhood assembly, in session on 15 November 2007, adopted the arms (azure, a fountain argent, in chief two scallops or) and the flag: a rectangular flag of 2:3 formed of two equal horizontal stripes, blue above and white below, with two yellow shells of 50 per cent of the width on the blue stripe, the first at 1/3 and the second at 2/3 of the length from the hoist.

features.role: two scallop shells at one and two thirds of the length
